title: Amazingly Sweet Mediterranean Sweet Potatoes Tagine
description: A sweet and gooey Mediterranean dish featuring sweet potatoes and massaman curry paste, perfect for a quick fix, and buddhist-temple-friendly as it is vegetarian and free from animal products.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the massaman curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cubed sweet potatoes, dates, prunes, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
